product_summary: Threat-intelligence and content-monitoring platform collecting 10,000+ sources, with AI extraction, a threat graph, report builder and an authenticated search API over team feeds.
current_data_sources: Clear and dark web threat sources

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: This is an authenticated endpoint so you will need to pass your authentication token

newsletter_capability_detail: Feedly already ingests newsletters through a per-user Feedly email address or forwarding: 'Feedly can ingest email newsletters directly into your feeds,' and it converts each email into an article treated like any other source. Coverage is user-subscribed, not a catalog with publication metadata or momentum.

evidence.quote: Feedly can ingest email newsletters directly into your feeds.

Continuously collect relevant threat signals from 10,000+ trusted clear and dark web sources.

likely_buyer_role: VP Product or Head of Content/Data Partnerships, Feedly Threat Intelligence
caveats: Gap disconfirmed: newsletters are already a supported source type, though only ones the customer subscribes to or forwards, and Feedly is positioned around CTI rather than GTM enrichment. A catalog-level play (publication discovery, sponsor/mention metadata, momentum across 26k publications) is still differentiated from one-email-at-a-time ingestion, but it is not an ingestion gap. No named partnerships contact found.
